maya: Quick smoke: rolled horizon-liteq-int8 canary (5%) overnight. Morning dashboard shows parse_failures on func-call outputs up from 0.2% -> 3.8%.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy horizon-liteq-int8 (5%) started by @maya at 2026-03-24T07:45:21Z

oncall-bot: Alert: route=/invoke/horizon-liteq-int8 parse_failure_rate=3.8% (threshold=1%)

maya: sample (redacted):
```
{"action":"update","args":{"items":[{"id":1,"qty":2}],},
}
```

leo: trailing comma + newline before final brace. looks like an extra token insertion at suffix.

sam: are failures correlated with streaming/batching? any kv-cache involvement?

maya: spike correlates with high continuous-batching utilization and bursts from a churny route. mirrored 2k-parity job queued (fp32 vs int8).

alex: quick hypothesis: quant-induced logit rounding nudges model to emit an extra "," token when closing arrays after code fences or nested lists.

qa: observed pattern in failing sample set: 72% have nested arrays, 18% include triple-backtick code blocks.

leo: mitigation idea (low-risk): enable canary-only soft-json-repair that strips trailing commas and closes dangling brackets; also set max_retries=1 for parse failures.

devex: alternative: reduce batch_window_ms for canary to 8ms to reduce interleaving; also enable parse-snapshotting to blob for all failures for offline audit. which should we do first?

maya: do both: soft-repair + retry=1 + batch_window_ms=8 for canary only. but keep a flag to disable repair if we see inflated downstream-mismatch.

oncall-bot: Will re-alert if parse_failure_rate > 6% or downstream_arg_mismatch > 0.25%

sam: after parity finishes, I'll post token diffs. plan: kv-cache-off replay slice (1%) and a tokenizer-split probe to check token id shifts.

ale x: i'll make a 300-prompt schema-eval (nested arrays + code fences) and report pass rates on fp32 vs int8.

qa: please tag repaired outputs in snapshots so we can review whether repair introduced argument hallucination.

devex: patch queued by @devex -> horizon-liteq-int8/canary (soft-json-repair, retry=1, batch_window_ms=8, snapshotting=on)


maya: TL;DR: int8 canary = suffix-token insertions causing trailing commas. mitigation rolled for canary: soft-repair + single retry + tighter batching + snapshots. follow-ups: parity token-diff, kv-cache mirror, tokenizer probe, schema-eval.

leo: noted. i'll watch dashboard and flag if downstream errors creep up.

sam: will post parity results in ~2h.

maya: thanks all. keep this thread for updates.
